page.layout: One printed page with running text in a single column. Along the lower left, beside the last paragraph, one marginal note in several short lines. The right edge of the scan shows part of the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: ne apud ipsos fiebat conjugium, solenni sacrificio facto,in quo panis farreus adhibebatur, quo simul vescebantur conjuges, quo etiam victimas respergebant, & sic mulier in manum viri conveniebat per Pontificem Maximum, & Dialem Flaminem. Ex quo modo confarreandi,matrimonia dicebant: disfolutionem verò matrimonii diffarreationem dicebant. Neque aliter faustum felixque matrimonium putabant Romani, nisi more folenni ante sacrificassent & libassent. Non tantùm igitur totum nuptiarum diem in sacrificiis transigebant, in quibus porcam immolabant: sed nyctelia etiam sua insuper habebant, quæ noctu celebrabant, quædam extra cubiculum genialem, omnibus astantibus ; quædam secretò in cubiculo, ne paranymphis quidem præsentibus. Quas ineptias & obscoenitates ex Varrone recensèt & eludit Augustinus lib.6.de civit.Dei, cap.9. & lib.7.cap.24. Festus sponsum & sponsam dictos vult, quòd ἀσπονδάς[?], hoc est,libationes, interpositis rebus divinis, facerent. Usque adeò interpositis sacrificiis & sacris ritibus sponsalia etiam contrahi apud ethnicos solita fuerunt.

Rationes benedictio-num & consecrationū matrimo-nialiū apud Christia-nos.Sunt autem publicæ conferationis coram ecclesia, & benedictionis per ecclesiæ ministrum inter Christianos, & honestissimæ atque necessariæ rationes. page.notes: Right edge shows part of the facing page (text from another page), not transcribed. The Greek word in the Festus passage is set in small type and is uncertain; it is most likely ἀσπονδάς (unlibated), marked [?]. The final word "humani" is split at the line end; its second part "mani" stands alone at the right below the text and is taken as the catchword. The marginal note is printed in small type and runs over several lines, with hyphens kept as printed.
